finding.title: The new test step fails on every pull request
finding.description: The performance test step runs `unittest discover` against `tools/perf/tests`, but the job's sparse checkout does not include `tools/perf/`. On every pull request, the start directory is absent, so the step fails instead of running the tests.

citations.citation:
steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Text-only guards: sources, scripts and agent skills; no assets or binaries.
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /tools/ci/
            /tools/factory/
            /gdext/src/
            /gdext/tests/
            /Project/project-keynes/**/*.gd
            /Project/project-keynes/data/native_binding_manifest.json
            /.*/skills/
            /docs/architecture/
            /docs/plans/
            /docs/factory/
            /AGENTS.md

evidence.explanation: The checkout includes `/tools/ci/` and `/tools/factory/`, but not `/tools/perf/`; the added step requires the missing directory.
